rationale: Claimant explicitly reported a stolen bike; theft coverage is active on the renters policy, and no third-party property damage or bodily injury is involved.
claim_summary: Blake Okafor reports a 2024 commuter bike stolen yesterday morning, estimated value $800. Renters policy POL-1007 covers theft with a $250 deductible. This is a low-severity single-item theft claim well within policy limits.
